description: Return a ready-to-copy manifest for all downloadable rigged-character and animation-clip artifacts on an owned animation batch or clip. Each entry includes stable artifactId and semantic role fields, plus a durable downloadUrl, suggestedPath, and loaderHint. Requires ownership, completed artifacts, and download permission. URLs are Mint CDN-backed and do not expose private provider details.
name: get_model_animation_artifact_manifest
title: Get Model Animation Artifact Manifest
